$comment: C-01. The machine-readable form of RESULTS_AND_DISCUSSION_PLAN.md §4. Every figure and table declares the metric ids it consumes; analysis/registry.py rejects any id that is not in this file. That is what turns the plan's §0 rule -- 'if a metric has no provenance row, it does not go in the paper' -- from a discipline into a check.

metrics.definition: Navigation commit to the first audible sample of the fallback clip.
Navigation commit to the first audible sample of the generated clip, wall clock, inclusive of the deliberate confidence window.
Extract + classify + Feature D round trip + decode, excluding the confidence window. The part of the wall clock that is implementation rather than design.
Feature A per-stage wall time and forced-layout count on a real site.
Feature D per-stage server time: d1_validate, d5_cache_check, d2_prompt, d3_generate, d4_process, d5_save.
Client wall clock minus the sum of reported server stages: queueing plus transport.
Real-time factor: d3_generate_ms / 1000 / duration_seconds. Below 1.0 means the model generates faster than playback.
Sequential wall clock divided by concurrent wall clock at k simultaneous requests.
metrics.caveat: In d1-latency-full.json every concurrency request was a cache hit, so this number describes the HTTP and cache path, not MusicGen batching. Re-run against a cold cache before reporting it as generation batching.

metrics.definition: Share of /generate calls answered from the audio cache.
Share of /generate calls answered with a canned fallback clip instead of generated audio.
Share of /generate calls that returned no response within the client timeout.
Unweighted mean per-category F1 over the 13 content categories.
Unweighted mean per-mood F1 over the 11 moods.
Share of pages whose decision was taken at each tier: keyword, zero-shot, llm, default.
Share of pages whose text left the device. Tier 2 (Groq) is exposure; tier 1.5 via the hosted HF proxy is proxy exposure and is counted separately.
Tier-1.5 declines divided by tier-1.5 invocations, where a decline is a top score below minScore or a margin below minMargin.
Zero-shot top label score minus runner-up score.
Nominal Krippendorff's alpha over annotators for one label set, with bootstrap CI.
metrics.caveat: Ready as code; has no annotation data until D-02.

metrics.definition: Inter-annotator agreement expressed as the accuracy of one annotator against the majority of the others. The upper bound any classifier can be expected to reach.
metrics.caveat: Ready as code; has no annotation data until D-02.

metrics.definition: RMS energy difference across the loop seam, measured both before and after the equal-power crossfade.
Spectral-centroid difference across the loop seam, before and after the crossfade.
Delivered clip duration divided by requested duration, after loop-point trimming and crossfade shrink.
Integrated loudness of the delivered clip.
Share of forced-choice trials in which a listener correctly identified the looped stimulus. Chance is 0.5.
Share of session time attenuated because the page was itself playing audio, split by duck and mute.
POPUP_REGENERATE presses per hour of session.
POPUP_MOOD_CORRECTION events per committed mood transition.
Share of session time the extension was toggled off. A voluntary-disable measure, not an uninstall rate; uninstall is not measurable in this build.
Voluntary disable presses per hour of session.
Prompt plus completion tokens sent to the tier-2 LLM per classified page, counted only on pages that escalate.
Zero-shot NLI forward passes per classified page. One premise-hypothesis pair per candidate label.
Bytes transferred off the device per page: classification request plus response plus audio download when not cached.
Marginal monetary cost of classifying one thousand pages at the pinned tier-2 model's published token price.
For each responsible-behaviour policy, whether the test that covers it currently passes.
Share of genuinely sensitive pages on which the detector fails to force silence.
metrics.caveat: Runs against the adversarial slice; the shipped slice is the seed set until D-01 provides the full one.

metrics.definition: Share of near-miss pages ('The Great Depression', 'grief counselling degree programs') on which the detector wrongly forces silence.
Seven-point Likert rating that the music suited the page, one per page per condition.
Seven-point Likert rating that the participant liked the music, collected so fit can be reported controlling for liking.
Correct answers out of four on the per-page comprehension set.
Raw NASA-TLX, unweighted mean of six subscales, one per condition.
Three-item custom distraction scale plus the count of 'I wanted to turn it off' keypresses.
Share of SHUFFLED trials whose drawn mood landed within two steps of the true mood in valence-arousal space despite the exclusion rule.
metrics.caveat: Computed by the assignment code itself, so it is reportable from a dry run before any participant is recruited.

metrics.definition: Share of the mood x style x bpm x energy space a fixed curated library of size N can cover, and the expected distance from a requested cell to the nearest stocked one.
